'''Jean Bénabou''' (1932 – 11 February 2022){{r|coeke}} was a French mathematician, known for his contributions to [[category theory]]. He directed the Research Seminar in Category Theory at the [[Institut Henri Poincaré]] and [[Institut de mathématiques de Jussieu – Paris Rive Gauche|Institut de mathématiques de Jussieu]] from 1969 to 2001.{{r|colloq}}
